messages:
jordan: FYI billing flagged multiple requests attributed to org-default project after teams used service-account impersonation. Can we make it easier to trace why a request landed in a given project?

anya: we should surface a compact token "lineage" in Console. not a full audit log, just the chain: origin -> proxies -> impersonator -> routed project.

kevin: technical note: must be verifiable. propose a signed provenance header from trusted edge proxies, `x-rw-provenance`. legacy proxies would be marked as unverified/inferred.

molly: privacy constraint: default to hashing org/project ids in telemetry. admin can enable readable labels for org admins only. retention policy controls how long lineage is kept.

daria: UX: small heatmap + timeline. heatmap shows common origins vs final project; clicking opens the event timeline with an action to re-run attribution or open the routing rule that matched.

kevin: ingest schema idea: event_fingerprint, provenance_verified(true|false), origin_type, origin_id_hash, final_project_hash, last_impersonator_hash, route_rule_id, ts. Keep sensitive ids hashed unless org opts in.

anya: fallback behavior question: if project claim missing we currently map to org-default project. Console should surface that and allow quick rollback of the routing policy or reassign historical attributions for billing corrections.

jordan: +1. Also need to show when routing policy changed in last 24h near the event timeline to speedroot cause.

molly: infra edge-case: private/on-prem customers won't call our signing service. plan: allow upload of verifier pubkey per-customer or HSM signing option. add config `provenance_mode: signed|inferred|disabled`.

ops-bot: scheduled canary for provenance spike: 2024-10-03T22:00:00Z.

sre-bot: incident #2420 created: "org-default attribution spike" linking here.

kevin: will draft header format + sample JSON and post RFC. keep payload compact to avoid large headers.

daria: I'll mock simple Console widgets (heatmap + timeline + small admin toggles). aim minimal so it's non-invasive.

molly: action items: kevin draft telemetry + header; daria/anya mock UI; ops schedule canary; jordan own spike ticket. keep scope tiny.

jordan: thanks, team. will follow up with spike ticket and assign owners.
